authority: Accepted task 12c3b bounded native dependency qualification after independent review and fresh shared capacity
scope: Four sequential ordinary fmt installs in new private per-triplet roots. Each dependency build uses one job; the pinned helper may run two Debug/Release CMake configure processes and their compiler probes concurrently. Repeat current writer/capacity/input checks under the canonical lease; native sandbox permits writes only under this private root plus /dev/null and denies network. Each install is limited to 600 seconds with 8 GiB reserve. Default and named profiles, all shared protected state and pinned source remain guarded. No shared installs, global config changes, binary cache, consumer build, containers mutation, remote publication or external providers.
